The Theme Contract

What a theme may assume, what it receives, what it must never do. Full book: docs/theme-contract.md. This page: the bakery, as baked.

The layout (bakery)

bridge/templates/bakery/page.html — one unified sidebar layout, worn by every page. The sidebar (left, full height):

  1. brand — {{logoHtml}} + {{siteName}}
  2. search + filter — theme furniture
  3. nav — {{navHtml}} (the page entries)
  4. footer — © {{year}} {{siteName}}, pinned to the bottom

Under 60rem the sidebar stacks to a top band; content flows under it.

Placeholders the layout fills

{{navHtml}} {{bodyHtml}} {{themeBase}} {{siteName}} {{claim}} {{claimHtml}} {{logoUrl}} {{logoHtml}} {{pageTitle}} {{seoHead}} {{year}}

Filled by fill() in bridge/serve.php; the bake fills the same names from docs/content/ (scripts/bake-docs.ts). All escaped except {{bodyHtml}} and {{seoHead}}, which core generates. A template carries no styles — it only links the one stylesheet.

Assets

  • <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{themeBase}}assets/theme.css"> — the ONE stylesheet
  • <script src="{{themeBase}}assets/menu.js" defer></script>
  • /bridge/assets/noto/noto.css — the fonts

In the bake {{themeBase}} is '' (assets sit next to the page) and the noto link is repointed to assets/noto/noto.css; theme.css, menu.js and the noto folder are copied into docs/build/assets/.

Search and filter

  • Search — client-side over the rendered nav (.sm-nav entries). No fetch, no core route, works for a stranger.
  • Filter — a bare scaffold: the .sm-filter select has no tag data door yet (no core tags endpoint). It stands honest and does nothing.

The class namespace

sm- is shared between core, the render pipeline, the editor and themes. Core emits sm-nav, sm-fallback, sm-notfound, claim, logo; the pipeline emits sm-slide, sm-module, sm-details, sm-embed, sm-image, sm-empty-slot, sm-video, sm-note, sm-note-tip, sm-note-warn, sm-more, sm-unknown-module. Themes extend the contract here — they emit no sm- classes of their own.

What a theme must never do

  • Assume DOM timing (some doors deliver the body asynchronously)
  • Style or depend on editor-internal classes (sm-edit-*, data-sm-*)
  • Carry styles in the markup — the one stylesheet holds them
  • Emit sm- classes of its own
  • Parse content HTML structurally — style it
